system.notes:
By day, appears as a mortal woman. At night, her head detaches from her motionless body and hunts for blood, dangling organs and viscera. Must soak in vinegar before reattaching.

AC 12, HP 16, ATK 2 bite +1 (1d6 + drain) and 1 hex, MV double near (fly), S +2, D +2, C +3, I +2, W +1, Ch +3, AL C, LV 3

Drain. Heals 1d6 HP, target permanently loses 1 CON. At 0 CON, target dies.

Greater Undead. Immune to morale checks. Only damaged by silver or magical sources.

Hex. Gaze at target in near. CHA 15+ or roll next attack with DISADV. Cannot use again for 1d4 rounds.

Separate. At night, head and torso separate. Both parts share HP.

Shadowfinder Complete Bestiary
